research_conclusions: Instrument epoch weak predictions/AUC/distributions and comparable eval losses before judging initialization or BN
Compare random+legacy, random+ImageNetNorm, pretrained+ImageNetNorm on the same192px cache; keep selection rule fixed
If BN comparison is needed, first isolate running-stat freeze; changing real batch also changes current missing-label loss weighting
Audit label observation bias and competition definitions alongside model work; missing is not zero or arbitrary .5
Separate model-only source changes from image preprocessing compatibility; preserve export integrity checks
Test resolution and physical crop separately; implement full UID sharding/merge verification before256+full cache
Keep gold out of train/selection; prior gold inspection means not a pristine final blind holdout; do not claim independent OOF for public weights
Verify own Kaggle execution early after source eligibility; maintain scored public baseline
